scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic proof and independently implemented rational shock-rate checks; no independently conducted external audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Population-level structural identification in a closed, homogeneous Poisson-abundance model with independent Bernoulli detections and independent Poisson false counts. No finite-sample accuracy, stability, broader count model, or biological generality is claimed.
title: Three-visit identification and exact moment feasibility for false-positive abundance counts
